items.name: Magical Girl Wife

alt_names.name: Mi Esposa Es Una Chica Mágica
My wife is a Magical Girl

items.summary: By day, she is just an ordinary married woman, but by night, she transforms into a magical girl. Taegon remains indifferent to his seemingly perfect wife, ‘Sora’. To anyone else, she epitomizes the ideal woman, but his affection lies with the magical girl ‘Pink Lumina’, leading him to overlook her. One fateful day, he uncovers the truth about Lumina’s identity... “My wife… is a magical girl?!”

items.name: Kono Fukushuu ni Gyaru wa Iranai

alt_names.name: この復讐にギャルはいらない
I Don't Need a Gal for This Revenge

items.alt_name: この復讐にギャルはいらない
items.summary: Nozomi Kashihara is a solitary hitman who has experienced the loss of his parents and has never felt affection throughout his life. He turned against the "family" that brought him up and has been living as an ordinary high school student. However, after rescuing a gal from his class from a group of delinquents, he unexpectedly starts to grow closer to her. Kashihara begins to have suspicions that she might be an assassin who is after him...

items.name: A Fractured Marriage
items.summary:
My companion of a decade is set to wed another woman. However, we haven’t even ended our relationship. Is this truly occurring?  
  
As Hyo-rim sinks into utter hopelessness regarding her circumstances, a mysterious figure emerges, extending a helping hand.  
  
Who is this enigmatic man, and can Hyo-rim genuinely prevent her beloved’s wedding?

items.name: The Prosecutor Is Getting Ahead!
items.summary:
Prosecutor Seo-jun, who previously believed his life would be a straightforward journey of success, chooses to disrupt the unfair system and claim the power he had long disregarded after observing a friend's demotion who was meant to have an easy path.

While devising a plan with that same friend, who is now serving as a whistleblower, he starts to receive enigmatic text messages from the future…

A fierce struggle for control over power commences—
and Seo-jun’s audacious ascent to the pinnacle begins with the messages from tomorrow!

items.name: My Lucky Encounter From The Game Turned Into Reality

alt_names.name: 奇縁 〜 ゲームと現実がリンクする

items.summary: "Who claims that revenge is pointless? It's quite enjoyable!" In a realm where magic coexists alongside noble rule, Adrian Lawrence appears to have been fortunate as the second son of a viscount. Nevertheless, Adrian is an outsider in a household dominated by his cunning step-mother and half-brother, both determined to remove him. Unbeknownst to them, Adrian engages in the game Chronicle Online, where he wields significant powers that can also manifest in reality! With the inheritance of the viscounty at stake, will Adrian be able to harness his abilities to advance his life in the real world?

items.name: The Fiancé After the Rain

alt_names.name: A New Fiancé After the Sorrow
To the Brother of the Husband I Loved

items.alt_name: A New Fiancé After the Sorrow
items.summary: Read The Fianc After the Rain / On the day she was supposed to marry a wealthy heir, a noblewoman's life is abruptly ended by a mysterious "accident." She awakens in a different body, realizing that her new persona is the fianc of her former groom's younger brother. Eager to uncover the identity of her murderer and reveal the hidden truths within her in-laws' conglomerate, her exhilarating second life dedicated to revenge and discovery commences.

items.name: The Foul

alt_names.name: The Foul โกงเกมรัก

items.summary:
Ever since inheriting his father’s debt as a teenager, Joo Hawon has been doing whatever it takes to buy his freedom back, whether that means working as a VIP dealer in the casinos of Macau, or taking other riskier jobs. In a world where money is worth more than lives, Hawon knows he’s always walking a fine line. But when a mysterious casino guest by the name of Kwon Taeha offers to pay off his debt if he successfully finishes a job on a cruise ship, it’s too good an offer to turn down–despite his instincts warning him of obvious danger. With lives and livelihoods at stake, could this man be Hawon’s savior? Or will he be the devil that lures Hawon to depths deeper than he ever imagined? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

items.name: Tokyo Fears Rhapsody

alt_names.name: อมนุษย์พันธุ์ซ่า ล่าสะท้านโตเกียว

items.summary:
Hachiro is the mightiest monster around, created to strike terror into humanity! But a chance encounter with ice cream makes him an instant fan of human culture, earning him the ire of his fellow Fears. Between rebelling against his overbearing creator and slaughtering ghoulish foes, Hachiro’s got a lot more than just ice cream on his plate! 

(Source: VIZ Media)

items.name: I Will Never Forget Your Fragrance
items.summary: Yuuto, who transferred from Tokyo to a rural high school, is spending a quiet school life, struggling to find a place where he can settle his mind in the unfamiliar environment. On a rainy day, he meets Saki, a girl with a mysterious aura. As a fellow transfer student, Saki is always bright and naturally blends in with people, and Yuuto slowly finds himself paying attention to her. Spending time together after school and growing closer, Yuuto suddenly realizes that Saki is not human. Caught in the act, Saki asks him to hide her identity, and Yuuto accepts the promise. Since that day, the two build short yet peaceful moments by taking pictures and sharing ordinary daily life together. However, a destiny is set where Saki cannot stay with Yuuto for long. A being who might disappear someday, and a person desperately holding onto those memories until the very end. Their encounter leaves a gradual, yet undeniable trace amidst their quiet daily lives.

items.summary: The VR game [Crimson Earth], set in a cyberpunk and Cthulhu mythos environment, is about to be released, and Wei Xin is lucky enough to be chosen as a beta tester. However, things take an unexpected turn when she discovers that she isn’t actually playing a VR game; instead, she has been transported into the reality of a parallel universe: one where a super AI tracks every action of its inhabitants. This era is dominated by superhumans, cyborgs, cults, and mutated beings…

items.name: Dungeon Porter
items.summary:
In a realm where only individuals with natural ability can take on the role of adventurers to conquer dungeons, the world has labeled "Nagi" as a porter who is unable to become an adventurer. 

However, if one successfully clears a dungeon, doesn’t that qualify them as an adventurer? 

Combat skills: 0! Survival capabilities: Max level! 
Join Nagi, the versatile porter, as he embarks on a dungeon conquest journey that challenges destiny!

items.name: The Law of Immutability
items.summary: Woori Nam has always been seen as the favored one—affluent, free-spirited, and incredibly fortunate. However, on the leap day of 2028, marking his 7th real birthday, everything takes a turn. A seemingly innocent reunion with an old classmate, Subin Shin, culminates in a horrific murder. Following this, Woori inexplicably finds himself back in high school, next to Subin who remains unaware that he has just taken the life of his deskmate. Caught in a perilous time loop where nearly every outcome leads to his demise at the hands of Subin, Woori becomes increasingly determined to alter his destiny. After numerous resets, Woori ultimately realizes that the key to his survival might lie in ensuring Subin’s happiness. With only one life remaining, Woori embarks on a mission to provide Subin with the most joyful life possible.

items.alt_name: The Banished Lifestyle Mage Who Aims to Be the Strongest Support ~Damage Dealer? No, I'm the Support!~
items.summary: Born into a renowned family of mages, the young Lyle was celebrated as a genius due to his extraordinary magical abilities. However, when it is revealed that he can only cast Lifestyle Magic—basic spells for household tasks, cooking, and agriculture—he is expelled from his home. Undeterred, Lyle embarks on a new journey: to become the greatest support mage in the world and leave his mark as an adventurer! This is the tale of a self-identified support character who inadvertently becomes unmatched, wielding the boundless potential of Lifestyle Magic.

items.alt_name: If You Don't Date, You Die!
items.summary:
Following a series of unfortunate relationships with nothing but "losers," Moon Joo-kyung becomes a dedicated workaholic in her 30s, completely abandoning the idea of love and dating. However, one day, she inadvertently becomes afflicted with a curse that causes her to "fall in love instantly." This dreadful curse compels her to confess her feelings to anyone she finds appealing immediately. If she resists falling in love, the consequence is death. Will Joo-kyung be able to endure this curse? If you don’t date, you die. (Literally.)

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Literally Original Webtoon Naver](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=846662), [Naver](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13633976)

items.name: The First Season
items.summary: Even when rumors spread that she was the daughter of a wealthy family, Ji-seo never bothered to correct them. As long as she kept her distance from everyone, no one would ever find out the truth.After all, being mistaken for a rich girl was far better than being looked down on for being poor.But the quiet, comfortable little world Ji-seo had built on a foundation of lies began to crumble before she could even enjoy it for two years.And it all started when she met the ‘real’ Shin Jae-eon.Unlike everyone else, Shin Jae-eon had everything—wealth, status, and the sharpness to see through even the smallest lie. If there was anyone who could uncover her secret, it was him.So Ji-seo did everything she could to stay away from him.Unfortunately, the more desperately she tried to avoid Shin Jae-eon……the more entangled their lives became.				+

items.summary:
As a zombie epidemic engulfs Seoul, the authorities abandon the city to its grim fate. In the midst of the turmoil, former special forces bodyguard Shinu strives to keep his nervous charge, Tebek, safe. However, with each passing day bringing them closer to their demise, the connection between them becomes increasingly difficult to ignore. Will love endure through an apocalypse?

items.name: Double date
items.summary: On the day he chose to reveal his feelings to his crush, his female friend Juyoung, she unexpectedly comes out as gay. To fix the predicament, he enlists his friend Yuwon to pose as his boyfriend... however, on the day of the date, when he realizes that the girlfriend Juyoung brought along is Yuwon's ex, the double date spirals into chaos...?
